mapper.select: SELECT d.Q_ID AS qId, q.Q_KEY AS qKey, d.OPT_ID AS optId, o.OPT_VALUE AS optValue, o.OPT_CODE AS optCode, d.ANSWER_TEXT AS answerText FROM TB_SURVEY_RESP_DTL d JOIN TB_SURVEY_Q q ON d.Q_ID = q.Q_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SURVEY_OPT o ON d.OPT_ID = o.OPT_ID WHERE d.RESP_ID = #{respId}

mapper.select: SELECT r.RECO_ID AS recoId, r.RANK_NO AS rankNo, r.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.DPST_NAME AS productName, p.DPST_INFO AS productInfo, p.DPST_DESCRIPT AS productDescription, p.DPST_CURRENCY AS productCurrency FROM TB_CUST_RECO_TOP3 r JOIN TB_DPST_PROD_INFO p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.DPST_ID WHERE r.CUST_CODE = #{custCode} AND r.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} ORDER BY r.RANK_NO ASC
